provenance.sourceDescription: OpenStruct controls G01/A01/Q/C using team-defined circles A/B and the downstream straight terrain from Duncan, Wright and Brandon (2014), section 7.7.7.
provenance.materialConvention: These geometry controls use gamma=100 pcf from the figure, not gamma=125 pcf from the manual slice tables. They are not a reproduction of the published critical circle.
provenance.waterConvention: The upstream reservoir does not act on the analyzed downstream mass; A01 uses only the prescribed piezometric pressure.
provenance.domainBaseConvention: The source foundation boundary is z=0 m. The registration domain closes at z=-0.3048 m (one foot lower), strictly below all terrain vertices. This domain extension never intersects the circular sliding masses, so physical inputs and numerical expectations are unchanged.
provenance.independence: Python standard library; closed-form circle/line intersections and area integral; no GeoStruct imports or production outputs.
provenance.scope: Regression/reference comparison only. Does not establish general solver tolerances, engineering acceptance or a global critical surface.

conversion.sourceForceConvention: lbf for a one-foot out-of-plane strip; divide by 0.3048 m when converting to kN/m

admissibility.scope: Strict reference screening only; not product defaults
